cosy-lesson.title: Chatting with an AI vs Chatting with a Human (B1-B2)

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Algorithm ≠ Intuition – a process or set of rules to be followed in calculations.

p.em: Example: The algorithm predicts what you want to read next.

cosy-blockquote.p: Empathy ≠ Apathy – the ability to understand and share the feelings of another.

p.em: Example: AI can simulate sympathy, but human empathy is genuine.

cosy-blockquote.p: Authenticity ≠ Artificiality – the quality of being authentic or genuine.

p.em: Example: Authenticity is key to meaningful friendships.

cosy-blockquote.p: Nuance ≠ Clarity – a subtle difference in or shade of meaning, expression, or sound.

p.em: Example: Human speech is full of subtle cultural nuance.

cosy-blockquote.p: Companionship ≠ Solitude – a feeling of fellowship or friendship.

p.em: Example: Pet ownership offers wonderful daily companionship.

cosy-blockquote.p: Dependency ≠ Independence – the state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something.

p.em: Example: Over-reliance on digital tools creates technological dependency.

cosy-blockquote.p: Spontaneity ≠ Premeditation – the condition of being spontaneous; natural unscripted behavior.

p.em: Example: Conversations with friends have natural spontaneity.

cosy-blockquote.p: Validation ≠ Rejection – recognition or affirmation that a person or feeling is valid.

p.em: Example: Seeking social validation online can be addictive.

cosy-blockquote.p: Reciprocity ≠ One-sidedness – the practice of exchanging things with others for mutual benefit.

p.em: Example: A healthy relationship requires emotional reciprocity.

cosy-blockquote.p: Isolation ≠ Community – the state of being isolated or alone.

p.em: Example: Social isolation harms mental health.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
Does conversing with an algorithm lack the emotional authenticity of human relationships?
★ Do you ever feel that digital communications lack true depth?

Can AI companions reduce social isolation for people living alone?
★ How do you maintain strong bonds with distant friends?

Why do humans value cultural nuance and humor in daily conversations?
★ Have you ever had a joke misunderstood in text messages?

Does chatting with AI create an unhealthy psychological dependency?
★ How many hours a day do you spend interacting with screens?

Is emotional reciprocity necessary for a conversation to feel fulfilling?
★ What makes you feel truly listened to by another person?
